theorems.statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn (m + k))) (G : Rn (m + k) → Rn m) (a : Rn (m + k)), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G V → a ∈ V → Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ G a) → ∃ (Ω : Set (WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k))) (Λ : WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k) → Rn (m + k)), IsOpen Ω ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Λ Ω ∧ InjOn Λ Ω ∧ IsOpen (Λ '' Ω) ∧ a ∈ Λ '' Ω ∧ Λ '' Ω ⊆ V ∧ (∀ p ∈ Ω, Function.Bijective (fderiv ℝ Λ p)) ∧ ∀ p ∈ Ω, G (Λ p) = WithLp.fst p
